display_long_description:
You are not playing Snake. You are INSIDE it.

Snake 3D ULTRA puts you at the center of a glowing neon universe where the classic Snake game comes alive around you in full virtual reality. Every wall pulses with color. Every turn feels real. Every food collected speeds you up toward an adrenaline rush you won't forget.

CLASSIC MODE — Master the grid.
Turn your snake through a 3D neon cube using your controller. Simple controls, deep challenge. As your score grows, so does your speed. 8 levels push you from relaxed cruise to heart-pounding sprint. The walls wrap around — exit one side, enter the other. There is no escape. Only skill.

ULTRA MODE — Become the snake.
No buttons. No joystick. Your head IS the controller. The snake follows your gaze through open 3D space in smooth, continuous flight. Look where you want to go. This is immersion at its purest.

THE NEON WORLD
Every surface glows. Every segment of your snake trails in rainbow color. A retro-futuristic universe built specifically for VR surrounds you completely from every angle. This is not a flat game with a VR camera. This is a world designed to be lived in.

- Deeply immersive neon retro visuals
- Classic and Ultra game modes
- 8 speed levels from casual to intense
- Wrap-around walls in all 6 directions
- Original soundtrack
- Quest 2, Quest Pro, Quest 3, Quest 3S

The most fun you will have inside a cube.
How long can you last?
